label: NECESSARY_2 classical GOD_4 root from the underived individual, act priority at first
description: Sibling of the composition from the join's underived individual (NecessaryClassicalGodRootFromUnderived.Registration.derive) with act priority at a first being (FirstBeingActPriority, the POTENCY_2 first-being instance) in place of act priority for every potency of the independently supplied potency parameter (IndependentPriority). On ONE signature carrier, Profile m, world w, q.3 a.4 profile p and predicate dictionary, the same 22 other premises with the same parameters give NecessaryClassicalGodRootAt: some n that is an actual root at w, the only actual root at w, NecessaryAt at w (NECESSARY_2), maximal in being and perfect, with represented esse/essence identity, firstness, no matter-form composition, remoteness from all, the signature IsGod (GOD_4), the nine case attributes and the primitive classical field. Lean: UnderivedRootPerfection.derive and PerfectRootPositiveIntellectWill.derive as in the registered composition, then the ClassicalGodFromPositiveRoot assembly restated in a local helper whose only change is that the root's pure actuality comes from ActPriorityAtFirst.facts (item 2: the first-being version with same-respect non-overlap gives that a first being is in potency in no respect) applied to the root's firstness, instead of FirstBeingNoPotency with the strong reading. The same free InPotency parameter (POTENCY_2) occurs in the weak premise, non-overlap, the eternity premise and the conclusion. The naming premise is the declared GOD_1 to GOD_4 sense bridge, as in the registered composition. No premise says that a potency of a being other than a first one has a prior being in act. Conditional consequence only; no premise, source reading or root truth is established, and the weak premise itself is concluded only conditionally (from the strong reading, or from the five composition-route premises of the act-priority batch).
